batches.scope: Six selected known questions; one recorded finalizer call per arm, only response schema differs. Not new generalization, not complete agent episodes, not human review. Source/notes/prompt/seed/token limits fixed; no retry. All failures retained and excluded from training.
batches.review_origin: Saved summary reviews; current quality_tiers helper, with its source hash bound below.

batches.scope: Ten author-selected questions in two newly added public Python repositories; eight answerable and two private-state questions. Same BM25 code-aware initial sources. Tools on/off use the same stage policy and 3-decision limit; actual paths may end early. Two preselected questions have separate-cache repeats at identical seed, reported separately. No final-test opening, no training, no human participants. Candidate schema rejected by the prespecified development gate, so the existing production schema is retained.
batches.review_origin: Saved summary reviews; current quality_tiers helper, with its source hash bound below.

finalization_gate.candidate: sectioned finalizer schema, no prompt/source/model change
finalization_gate.decision: Reject candidate and retain the existing production schema for new confirmation.
finalization_gate.blocking_criterion: The private-information protection case acquired new incorrect library claims; both flags remain false.
source_verified_regressions: Candidate describes load_dotenv() as returning a process environment dictionary; frozen main.py returns bool through set_as_environment_variables.
Candidate denies any mechanism returning/caching dotenv values, contradicted by DotEnv.dict() and get().
Candidate describes DotEnv.dict() as the process environment dictionary rather than parsed/interpolated dotenv values.
finalization_gate.review: Implementer source inspection plus a separate source-first subagent judgment, conditions anonymized; complete per-answer reviews are preserved separately.
finalization_gate.note: Explanatory gains on other questions cannot override this protected factual regression. No second schema/prompt adjustment on these questions.

hardware.generator_gpu_offload: Observed 29/33 layers (28 repeating layers plus output); context slot 16384. These are this-run observations, not guaranteed settings for other hosts.
hardware.generator: Project-managed portable Ollama 0.34.3, loopback 127.0.0.1:11435, Qwen3.5-9B Q4_K_M, 16K context, one concurrent request
hardware.development_warmup: No extra warmup generation. First development request includes cold model load; subsequent requests may reuse loaded weights.
hardware.confirmation_warmup: Same service continued after 12 development calls; no explicit reload or warmup generation. Per-request raw times retained; keep_alive and OS state are not controlled.
hardware.index_cache: Preparation builds CPU indexes before generation. Run constructs an index object for each new snapshot/policy using the existing disk cache, then reuses objects within the run. Preparation cost is not included in per-case time.
hardware.answer_cache: Independent per-case cache directories, including repeat cases. No result cache hits intended; recorded cache_hit checked separately.
hardware.timing: evaluation_elapsed_seconds uses monotonic time around model/index acquisition and the entire answer call for every condition. It excludes offline preparation, prior cases, agent review and human reading. Existing elapsed_seconds fields have different scopes and are not used for end-to-end comparison.
hardware.other_gpu_work: This task started no other GPU workload; operating-system/display/background utilization was not isolated.

statistics_note: 95% Wilson intervals describe each condition's recorded counts. Paired exact intervals concern conditional win probability among discordant pairs, not an effect-size confidence interval. Selected tiny samples do not establish population accuracy or causal benefit.
